surfaces.name: events/subscriptions/passive inbox
surfaces.reason: Existing observers/filtering and native cursors stay on the single edge. Central cursor CAS, outbox claims/retries retain native event IDs. Expiry CAS preserves the original temporary ceiling; imported historical delivery adoption requires qualification; no second loop starts.

surfaces.name: collaboration
surfaces.reason: Reuses existing Access/Entra HTTP, capability/grant isolation, proposal/review/SSE services behind lease gate. Synchronous encrypted state remains single-edge; no claim that collaboration state became DO-authoritative.

surfaces.name: owner/caller MCP routes
surfaces.reason: Original MCP auth/role registration and caller grants/pending routing remain unchanged behind request lease gate. No generic raw forwarding or new central MCP principal.

surfaces.name: policy revocation
surfaces.reason: Persisted scope tightening, grant revision and origin/executor revocation checks. Production identity policy mapping not provisioned.

surfaces.name: diagnostics
surfaces.reason: Retained encrypted rows migrate, but runtime metrics/stall profiling and central retention queries are not replaced.

surfaces.name: budgets
surfaces.reason: Atomic central host/UTC-day and thread/provider caps across mutation kinds; original edge service enforces runtime/provider/approval limits. Legacy current-day usage conversion remains fail-closed before activation.

surfaces.name: creation/continuations/thread settings
surfaces.reason: Exact existing service schemas including live answers and dedicated fixed follow-up; mandatory central coordinator used by MCP/collaboration mutation gate. Production grants/trust mapping not provisioned.

surfaces.name: state migration/rollback
surfaces.reason: Quiescence/segmented import/readback/current-state export tested. Not a production restore tool or live rollback promise.

surfaces.name: cadence oversight
surfaces.reason: No goal-level central overview is claimed; associated stored records retained opaquely if present.
